answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake in a cryptographic anchor contract where identity minting burns tokens at a superlinear cost $O(n^2)$. Sybil swarms trying to mine hollow identities without backing face quadratic burning fees, making large-scale spoofing mathematically unviable. The system enforces this friction with ferrous hardness, ensuring attacker costs scale exponentially beyond any extractable payoff.
